key_insight: The proposed generative forecasting framework significantly improves ultra-short-term photovoltaic ramp event forecasting.
engineering_relevance: This work enhances grid stability in solar-integrated power systems through advanced AI-driven predictions.
method: Integrates PhyDiffNet for future sky video prediction.
Employs RaPVFormer for ramp-aware PV output forecasting.
Forecasts ramp events up to 16 minutes ahead with 1-minute resolution.
evidence_signal: The framework achieves a 10% increase in Critical Success Index (CSI) for PV ramp detection based on quantitative evaluations.
watch_item: The model's performance may vary under extreme or unexpected weather conditions.
paper_title: High-Fidelity Full-Sky Video Prediction for Photovoltaic Ramp Event Forecasting
